title_sq: Tek "Lion Residence 2", Shitet Super Apartament 2+1, Me Pamje Dhe Orientim Perfekt !!
description_sq: Tek "Lion Residence 2", Shitet Super Apartament 2+1, Me Pamje Dhe Orientim Perfekt !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 19 banim te nje kompleksi te ri 34-katesh ne faze ndertimi karabina. Lion 2 Residence eshte nje projekt multifunksional shume afer qendres se qytetit me nje fasade teresisht ekologjike dhe te gjelberuar. Pozicionimi i kompleksit prane rruges kryesore e ben lehtesisht te aksesueshem dhe te pershtatshem si per investim ashtu edhe per banim. Zona ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme. Apartamenti ka orientim Jug cka i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites dhe me pamje fantastike. Organizimi i brendshem eshte si me poshte: salloni i ndenjes i bollshem me dalje ne ballkon i cili te ofron pamje fantastike nga te qytetit, dhoma matrimoniale dhe me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi tjeter dhe dy tualete.
title_en: At "Lion Residence 2", Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with a perfect view and orientation!!
description_en: At "Lion Residence 2", Super Apartment 2+1 for sale, with a perfect view and orientation!! The apartment is located on the 19th residential floor of a new 34-storey complex under construction. Lion 2 Residence is a multifunctional project very close to the city center with a completely ecological and green facade. The positioning of the complex near the main road makes it easily accessible and suitable for both investment and residence. The area offers all the necessary services. The apartment has a South orientation, which allows natural light throughout the day and a fantastic view. The internal arrangement is as follows: spacious living room with access to the balcony which offers a fantastic view of the city, matrimonial room with access to the balcony, another bedroom and two toilets.
